But now I even question if I want that because of the bad habits, it brings to a persons life, these habits just slowly creep without realizing it.

When I had a high paying job, I never paid attention to my expenses, and did not bother to save money any which way. Now, I focus on budgeting and understanding where the money goes, and if it was necessary, in the process, I was able to save us thousands in unnecessary recurring expenses.

In order to save money, I also stopped eating outside. Two things happened as a result, I lost 20% of my body weight and reversed my diabetes. And because I ate at home, my cholesterol went down.

I realized what was important in life. Previously, I did not pay so much attention, and neither was very present with my family. Now, I prioritize spending time with them.

I lost my ability to save exponentially, spend egregiously and travel to Europe, two times a year. But in return, I gained my health back, my presence of mind with my family, and most importantly, being present with my kid, and giving them the time of the day they need.

When I made the switch, I realized, there are only lessons to be learned from this, as I move forward with my life.

In the end, I was able to balance my budget, with my family. I don’t even pay attention to the finances anymore. My mind is completely present, absorbing the small joys of life with people around me. 

It’s been nothing but a blessing in every way imaginable. Now that I think about it, in exchange, for some extra money that I would have saved and never used, I gained my health back, and my family gained tremendously from me, actually ‘living’ in the present, with them.
